name: Agatha | Mindmaker OS | Content Angle Approval

parameters.jsCode:
const webhookData = $('Webhook Trigger').item.json;
const angles = webhookData.angles || [];
const weekOf = webhookData.week_of || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

// Enrichment from Cleo Newsletter Sweep
const enrichment = $('Cleo Newsletter Sweep').first()?.json || {};
const identity_prepend = $('Build Identity Prepend').first().json.identity_prepend || '';
const plan_stale = $('Build Identity Prepend').first().json.plan_stale || false;
const themes = enrichment.newsletter_themes || [];
const notes = enrichment.inspiration_notes || [];

const enrichmentBlock = (themes.length > 0 || notes.length > 0)
  ? '

<recent_context>
What Krish has been reading in newsletters this week:
' +
    (themes.length > 0 ? themes.map(t => '- ' + t).join('
') : '(none)') +
    '

Angles from the Cleo inspiration folder:
' +
    (notes.length > 0 ? notes.map(n => '- ' + n).join('
') : '(none)') +
    '

Use this context to bias toward angles that connect to themes Krish is already engaging with, or that counter a dominant narrative.
</recent_context>'
  : '';

const prompt = identity_prepend + 'You are Agatha, COO of Mindmaker OS. Select the 2 strongest LinkedIn angles for Krish to choose from this week.

<krish_voice>
His differentiators: British-Australian-Brooklyn hybrid. Opens with opinion or provocation, never context. Specific and personal beats generic. Only he can write it - it relies on his real experience or POV. Warm with people, sharp on ideas.
</krish_voice>

<selection_criteria>
Prioritise angles that:
- Have a provocation strong enough to stop the scroll
- Could only come from Krish specifically (not any AI founder)
- Avoid: transformative, ecosystem, innovative, cutting-edge, "In today's landscape", or anything that sounds generated

Deprioritise: trend-chasing, generic industry takes, anything that opens with context rather than opinion
</selection_criteria>' + enrichmentBlock + '

<angles>
' +
  angles.map((a, i) => (i+1) + '. ' + a.title + '
Hook: "' + a.hook + '"
Angle: ' + a.angle).join('

') +
  '
</angles>

Return a clean Telegram message (markdown) with the top 2 angles, each with: title, the opening hook, and a one-line reason why it works for Krish specifically.';

return { prompt, angles, week_of: weekOf, plan_stale };

parameters.responseBody: {"status": "success", "message": "Content angles sent to Agatha for approval"}
